description: This header file declares the Response class within the WebSockets::JsonRpc namespace, which inherits from a Message class and provides methods related to JSON-RPC response handling such as retrieving IDs, checking for result or error presence, and validation.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: A class representing a JSON-RPC response message with methods to access response details.

methods.name: ~Response
methods.description: Default destructor for the Response class.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the response message.

methods.name: isResult
methods.description: Checks if the response contains a result.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result object from the response.

methods.name: isError
methods.description: Checks if the response indicates an error.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Retrieves the error object from the response.
